title: FPPSimDriver::Advance has no lower clamp — negative delta causes UB uint64 cast and runaway step loop
detail: Only the upper bound is clamped. A negative DeltaSeconds makes AccumulatedSeconds negative; static_cast<uint64_t> of a negative double is UB (wraps ~1.8e19), so the while loop steps unboundedly — bTerminal is never set in slice-1, and Step always advances on forward ticks.
recommended_fix: Clamp both ends: DeltaSeconds = FMath::Clamp(DeltaSeconds, 0.0f, MaxFrameDelta); — the header comment already promises a 'clamped float accumulator'.

title: PacketGridPos ZeroVector sentinel collides with a legal grid (0,0) position — bInPrev misclassified
evidence:
const bool bInPrev = PPViewGeometry::PacketGridPos(PrevSnapshot, Packet.Id) != FVector2D::ZeroVector;
			const FVector2D FromGrid = bInPrev ? PPViewGeometry::PacketGridPos(PrevSnapshot, Packet.Id) : ToGrid;
detail: PPViewGeometry.h:69 returns ZeroVector for 'not in this snapshot' and line 90 for a missing FromNode — indistinguishable from a packet genuinely positioned at grid (0,0). Such a packet is misread as absent, so its dot snaps instead of easing.
recommended_fix: Have PacketGridPos report membership via an out bool/TOptional and test that explicitly, instead of comparing the returned position against ZeroVector.

title: Node coloring keys source role on Id == SCENARIO_SOURCE — terminals with non-zero ids all render as sinks
detail: The branch assumes the source terminal is always node id 0 (current fixture spawn order). Any future fixture spawning a terminal first that isn't the source — or a second source — renders it sink-blue; no role data is carried.
recommended_fix: Carry an explicit source/sink role (or demand-origin flag) in PPView::FNodeView instead of deriving it from the fixture-order node id.
